start.welcome: 👋 Ah, there you are, Traveler. I'm Lauma, your companion for builds, rankings, and every step of your Genshin journey. ✨ 🔗 Begin by linking your UID: /genshinlogin <UID> Need a hand? Use /help to explore all my commands and features. 💫
help.text: 📖 Here's everything I can help you with, Traveler. Account /genshinlogin <UID> — link your Genshin UID /genshinlogout — unlink your account /myuid — show your linked UID /myinfo — show your account info Characters /mycharacters (/myc) — browse your showcased characters /inspect <UID> — inspect another player's showcase Spiral Abyss /abyss — current Abyss /preabyss — previous Abyss /abysscard — current Abyss card /preabysscard — previous Abyss card Imaginarium Theater /theater — current Theater /theatercard — Theater card Redeem /redeem <code> — redeem a gift code for your account More /banner — banner information /build_guide — build recommendations /settings — your settings /language — change language I'm always here when you need me. ✨
account.login_usage: Share your UID with me like this: /genshinlogin <UID> For example: /genshinlogin 901211014
account.linked: ✨ Wonderful — I've linked you to UID {uid}. You only need to do this once. Shall we take a look? Try /mycharacters.
account.relinked: 🔄 All set — I've updated your linked UID to {uid}.
account.logout_success: 👋 I've unlinked your account, Traveler. Come back whenever you like.
account.logout_none: Hmm, you don't have an account linked with me yet.
account.myuid_none: You haven't linked a UID with me yet. Use /genshinlogin <UID> and we'll begin.
characters.title: 🎴 Your showcased characters Pick one and I'll show you its build.
characters.title_other: 🎴 Showcase for UID {uid} Pick a character and I'll show you its build.
characters.empty: Your showcase looks empty, Traveler. Add a few characters to your in-game showcase and I'll fetch them for you.
inspect.usage: Tell me whose showcase to inspect, like this: /inspect <UID> For example: /inspect 901211014
redeem.usage: 🎁 Tell me which code to redeem, Traveler: /redeem <code> For example: /redeem GENSHINGIFT
redeem.not_linked: 🔒 Let's link your account first I'll need to know who you are before redeeming codes, Traveler. Link once with: /genshinlogin <UID> Then come right back and try /redeem <code>. ✨
redeem.link_note:
🔹 Tap the button below to claim it on the official HoYoverse page — I've filled the code in for you.
📬 Your rewards will arrive by in-game mail. Enjoy, Traveler! ✨
redeem.success_note: 📬 Your rewards are on their way and will arrive by in-game mail shortly. 🎉
redeem.invalid: ❌ That code doesn't look right {code} isn't a valid gift code, Traveler. Codes are letters and numbers only — double-check for typos and try again. 🔍
redeem.expired: ⌛ This code has expired {code} is no longer active, Traveler. Gift codes only last a short while — keep an eye out for fresh ones! 🌸
redeem.already: ⚠️ Already claimed You've already redeemed {code} on this account, Traveler. Each code can only be used once. 🛡️
redeem.wrong_region: 🌍 Wrong region for this code {code} isn't valid for your account's server, Traveler. Some codes are region-specific — try one for your region. 🔹
redeem.server_error: 🚫 The redemption service is busy I couldn't reach HoYoverse to redeem {code} just now, Traveler. Please give it a moment and try again. 🛡️
ranking.title: 🏆 Akasha Ranking
ranking.unavailable: No Akasha ranking for this one just yet.

abyss.unavailable: I don't have your Spiral Abyss data yet, Traveler.

theater.unavailable: I don't have your Imaginarium Theater data yet, Traveler. Make sure it's shown on your in-game profile.

build_guide.unavailable: I don't have build recommendations to share just yet.

language.set: ✅ Wonderful — I'll speak {language} with you from now on.
stats.title: 📊 Bot Statistics
error.generic: ⚠️ Oh dear — something went wrong on my end. Let's try again in a little while.
error.invalid_uid: ❌ That doesn't look like a valid Genshin UID, Traveler. It should be 9 or 10 digits starting with 6/7/8/9 (or 16/17/18/19), e.g. 901211014.
error.not_linked: You haven't linked a UID with me yet, Traveler. Use /genshinlogin <UID> first.
error.not_your_menu: 🚫 This menu belongs to another Traveler. Send the command yourself to use it.
error.profile_private: 🔒 I can't peek into this profile — it's private, or the character showcase is hidden. Enable the showcase in-game and we'll try again.
error.empty_showcase: This profile's showcase is empty. Add characters in-game and I'll take another look.
error.character_not_found: I couldn't find that character in the showcase, Traveler.
error.data_unavailable: I can't reach that data right now. Let's try again a little later.
error.ranking_unavailable: Akasha ranking data isn't available at the moment.
error.api_unavailable: 🌐 The data service is resting for a moment. Please try again shortly.
error.rate_limited: 🐌 We're going a touch too fast — give it a moment and try again.
error.network: 🌐 I had trouble reaching the data service. Let's try again shortly.
error.datastore_unavailable: 💾 I couldn't save that right now — my database is unreachable. Please try again in a moment.
